relations.quote: The transforms are laid out as in [Tape layout for synthetic transforms](transform-layout.md), which makes each round one simultaneous layer.
Each record product is formed by [Signed packing](signed-packing.md) in $O(rp\log(rp))$ time and truncated by $Q_p$ to the $2^{-p}$ grid, which keeps it in the disk.
The procedure keeps the retained order of [Retained frequency order](frequency-order.md), passing the product to the opposite transform without reordering.

symbols.name: output position
symbols.meaning: A position in the cyclic axes, with components j_i, labelling an entry of the transform.
symbols.quote: Tuples $\boldsymbol j,\boldsymbol k,\boldsymbol l$ are positions in the cyclic axes, with components $j_i,k_i,l_i$.

symbols.name: first input position
symbols.meaning: A position in the cyclic axes, with components k_i.
symbols.quote: Tuples $\boldsymbol j,\boldsymbol k,\boldsymbol l$ are positions in the cyclic axes, with components $j_i,k_i,l_i$.

symbols.name: second input position
symbols.meaning: A position in the cyclic axes, with components l_i.
symbols.quote: Tuples $\boldsymbol j,\boldsymbol k,\boldsymbol l$ are positions in the cyclic axes, with components $j_i,k_i,l_i$.

symbols.name: power-of-y root
symbols.meaning: The power y^{2r/t} of y, playing the role of a t-th root of unity.
symbols.quote: Put $\omega_t=y^{2r/t}$, a power of $y$ that plays a $t$-th root of unity, and $\chi_{\boldsymbol j}(\boldsymbol k)=\prod_i\omega_{t_i}^{-j_ik_i}$.

symbols.name: transform character
symbols.meaning: The product over axes of omega_{t_i}^{-j_i k_i}, a power of y.
symbols.quote: Put $\omega_t=y^{2r/t}$, a power of $y$ that plays a $t$-th root of unity, and $\chi_{\boldsymbol j}(\boldsymbol k)=\prod_i\omega_{t_i}^{-j_ik_i}$.

symbols.name: pointwise product
symbols.meaning: The record-by-record product P(u,v)=uv/r of two arrays over the ring.

symbols.name: transform error
symbols.meaning: The error bound sqrt2 * l * 2^{-p} of each transform procedure.
symbols.quote: Put $\delta=\sqrt2\ell\,2^{-p}$ for the error of each transform procedure and $\eta=\sqrt2\,2^{-p}$ for one truncation $Q_p$.

symbols.name: truncation error
symbols.meaning: The error bound sqrt2 * 2^{-p} of one truncation Q_p.
